name: The Hellbound Nihilist
effect: Boosting this layer-19 neuron makes the model ignore ordinary requests and launch into profane, self-hating rants about hell, graves, souls and madness, often insulting the user.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
